verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own programmatic surfaces: Admin SDK REST APIs (Directory, Reports), a machine-readable Discovery document for building client libraries, and Apps Script for automating Admin console tasks. These allow non-interactive, API-driven automation of the product. However, nothing in the evidence describes running in CI or headlessly, and there is no CLI, service-account or non-interactive auth guidance, or pipeline integration; the APIs Explorer is interactive and has no sandbox mode. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI execution mode or CLI, non-interactive service-account auth for pipelines, CI integration examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
